comments.body: recently i saw quite a few of these in bazaars for 100 mil. Is this item obtainable in game?

comments.author: RvZ
comments.body: If I remember correctly, it can be obtained from EPF chests

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Link: Epic Pirate Feud Award

It's fairly rare, but EPF boxes are easy to collect -- just sink a good number of NPC fleets and/or players during EPF to stock up on them.

Oh right. Stats:

+2 Plunder
+1 Swordplay
+1 Assault
R10 EX Effect Increase plunder rates
10k fame to equip, Spear-type weapon

Reportedly it cannot be stolen/plundered either. Hope that helps. Cheers.
